title: F1 Fantasy Team Fantasy Points Leaderboard
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f1fantasy:team team_points=*
| stats sum(team_points) as total_value, avg(team_points) as avg_value by round_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks race round values by total and average fantasy points across F1 Fantasy team events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `team_points` values for each F1 Fantasy team event and review total and average fantasy points by race round.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total fantasy points.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which race round shows the biggest fantasy points numbers in your F1 Fantasy team data.
